title: Even Ledger
description: Given an array of integers nums, compute the alternating sum: add the elements at even indices and subtract the elements at odd indices (S = nums[0] - nums[1] + nums[2] - nums[3] + ...). An empty array scores 0. Use 64-bit integers; inputs fit so the exact result fits in a signed 64-bit integer.

examples.label: Example 2
examples.explanation: A single element at an even index is added.

constraints: The exact alternating sum fits in a signed 64-bit integer.
